tools.name: dreamagent_list_projects
tools.description:
List the user's DreamAgent projects.

Returns each project's name, ID, type, status, and live domain (when
available). Use when the user asks to see, find, select, or check their
projects — and ALWAYS before modifying a project when its ID is not
already known (resolve names to IDs here first).

tools.name: dreamagent_list_files
tools.description:
List the file tree of a DreamAgent project (source files only —
hidden files like .env are excluded). Use before reading or editing
a file to find the correct path.

tools.name: dreamagent_read_file
tools.description:
Read a source file from a DreamAgent project. file_path is the
project-relative path (from dreamagent_list_files), e.g.
"src/pages/Home.tsx" or "telegram/main.py". Hidden files (.env) and
binaries are not readable.

tools.name: dreamagent_edit_file

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: dreamagent_list_global_integrations, dreamagent_list_project_env, dreamagent_list_superpowers, dreamagent_get_file_diff, dreamagent_list_commits, dreamagent_create_project, dreamagent_chat, dreamagent_list_sessions, dreamagent_get_chat_status, dreamagent_get_edit_progress · Private data: dreamagent_list_global_integrations, dreamagent_list_project_env, dreamagent_list_files, dreamagent_read_file, dreamagent_edit_file, dreamagent_write_file, dreamagent_get_file_diff, dreamagent_delete_file, dreamagent_commit_push, dreamagent_build_publish, dreamagent_create_project, dreamagent_list_sessions, dreamagent_get_chat_status, dreamagent_screenshot_website · Public sink: dreamagent_edit_file, dreamagent_write_file, dreamagent_build_publish, dreamagent_design_mode, dreamagent_create_project · Destructive: dreamagent_write_file, dreamagent_delete_file, dreamagent_commit_push, dreamagent_create_project, dreamagent_get_chat_status, dreamagent_get_edit_progress, dreamagent_cancel_chat.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: dreamagent_list_global_integrations, dreamagent_list_project_env, dreamagent_list_superpowers, dreamagent_get_file_diff, dreamagent_list_commits, dreamagent_create_project, dreamagent_chat, dreamagent_list_sessions, dreamagent_get_chat_status, dreamagent_get_edit_progress · Private data: dreamagent_list_global_integrations, dreamagent_list_project_env, dreamagent_list_files, dreamagent_read_file, dreamagent_edit_file, dreamagent_write_file, dreamagent_get_file_diff, dreamagent_delete_file, dreamagent_commit_push, dreamagent_build_publish, dreamagent_create_project, dreamagent_list_sessions, dreamagent_get_chat_status, dreamagent_screenshot_website · Public sink: dreamagent_edit_file, dreamagent_write_file, dreamagent_build_publish, dreamagent_design_mode, dreamagent_create_project · Destructive: dreamagent_write_file, dreamagent_delete_file, dreamagent_commit_push, dreamagent_create_project, dreamagent_get_chat_status, dreamagent_get_edit_progress, dreamagent_cancel_chat

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
